tagline: Leading materials science company serving high-growth markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting overall business performance and Dow's sensitivity to economic cycles and supply-demand dynamics

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total net sales of the company across all operating segments and geographic regions
kpis.description: Net sales of Dow Inc. decreased 7% in 2025 to $40 billion compared to $43 billion in 2024
kpis.signal: Decrease in net sales driven by reduced demand across all segments and regions

kpis.name: Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across all manufacturing sites in 29 countries
kpis.description: Dow Inc. employed approximately 34,600 people in 2025, stable year-over-year
kpis.signal: Workforce stability maintained during period of revenue decline

risks.title: Macroeconomic Recession
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly references macroeconomic uncertainty and supply-demand dynamics as factors impacting sales across all segments and regions. 7% revenue decline demonstrates direct exposure to economic cycles.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in competitive markets with local price declines driven by supply-demand dynamics, indicating pricing pressure and margin compression risk

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company subject to environmental and safety regulations; no material regulatory violation disclosed but ongoing compliance costs represent operational risk

risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrade
risks.score_rationale: Company's financial leverage and declining earnings create risk of credit rating downgrade, which would increase borrowing costs and access constraints

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Primary exposures to natural gas, crude oil, ethylene and propylene feedstocks create significant margin volatility that cannot always be hedged effectively

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company (through Union Carbide) faces ongoing asbestos litigation with 7,158 unresolved claims as of Dec 31, 2025, increasing from 5,813 in 2024

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Asbestos liabilities and environmental regulations create ongoing reputational exposure that could impact stakeholder confidence

ai_positioning.summary: Dow Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing
